## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5); confirmed by strong sector participation and cross-sector top performers, but note a MAJOR divergence among mega-cap tech names.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND — Utilities breadth: 9/10 positive. Consumer Discretionary strong: F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND — Consumer Disc. breadth: 12/14 positive. Healthcare leadership: LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND — Healthcare breadth: 14/17 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials showing Sector Weakness: DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND — Materials breadth: 4/11 positive. Industrials in Internal Rotation with notable weakness: DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND — Industrials breadth: 12/15 positive. Communication/Media showing internal strain: TTWO (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION — Communication breadth: 7/10 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5) — rotation-driven outperformance across Tech, Utilities and Consumer Disc.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND, DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Materials/Industrials and select high-multiple names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +79.45%) ABOVE TREND. Watch for MAJOR divergence: several mega-caps (NVDA, GOOGL, MSFT) are in CORRECTION even as broader momentum extends.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed: AAPL (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND, but NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION — Tech breadth: 18/24 positive. Net: broad tech participation but mega-cap rotation and short-term exhaustion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive: JPM (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +6.70%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +0.88% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY — Financials breadth: 16/20 positive. Style: rotation into cyclicals/financials evident but mixed signals persist.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare strong and news-driven: LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +1.60%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +9.56%) CORRECTION — Healthcare breadth: 14/17 positive. Positive sentiment and earnings catalysts underpin leadership but watch regulatory headlines.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials, select cyclicals and resilient consumer names (JPM (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY, F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +5.35%) CORRECTION) and reduce exposure to structurally weak names (INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — monitor mega-cap tech divergence before shifting core exposures.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND — catalysts and strong flows. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND, DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND — risk of momentum unwinding.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY; Utilities breadth: 9/10 positive) and Healthcare (LLY, MRK) on news flow. BEARISH: Materials (DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND; Materials breadth: 4/11 positive) and pockets of Industrials where litigation/earnings headlines pressure names.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA reclaiming near-term 50-day range to signal resumption (NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION). AAPL holding its 1M uptrend maintains tech leadership (AAPL (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND). INTU breaking further below short-term support would confirm broader tech dispersion (INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND). JPM holding this week's gains confirms Financials' rotation (JPM (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+65): triple‑agonist GLP-1 headline; price confirms with LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND — accumulation. CAT (+50): Evercore bullish note; CAT (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +5.35%) CORRECTION — sentiment positive but short-term pullback. ROST (+50): beat/guide lift; ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MA (-50): market chatter on payments; MA (1W: +0.88% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY — news offsets recent strength, watch flow. UNH (-45): regulatory scrutiny headlines; UNH (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +9.56%) CORRECTION — sentiment at odds with multi-week strength. DE (-45): lawsuit noise; DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming operational risk. HD (-45): cautious analyst notes; HD (1W: +5.23% | 1M: -7.96%) RECOVERY — divergence between news and short-term bounce.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, style mixed / no clear leadership. LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND and F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among mega-cap tech (NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION) and selected bearish news names (MA, UNH) — monitor for trend confirmation before reallocating core exposure.
